newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Bangkok Expressway rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bangkok Expressway rated sell.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd on Wednesday rated Bangkok Expressway Plc a "sell" on the expressway operator's lower-than-expected fourth-quarter profit.

"Bangkok Expressway has announced lower-than-expected fourth-quarter and full-year 1996 net earnings. Clearly the rise in the toll revenue in the fourth quarter was much lower than the rise in expenses," Asia Equity said in a new report.
At 0745 GMT, Bangkok Expressway was down half a baht at 25.75
Bangkok Expressway posted a 34 percent drop in its 1996 consolidated profit to 398 million baht from 600 million in the previous year, it said.

Asia Equity said the Bangkok Expressway's drop in its net profit in 1996 was attributed to a big jump in the company's operating expenses, foreign exchange losses, rising depreciaiton expenses and high interest payments.
